comments.body: ETH generally only looks at transcripts, not work experience, so yes it matters, however the ranking matters more. If I recall correctly they want top10% of your graduating class for most masters/ direct phd programs, if you have e this you gpa is not that relevant. Also “engineering” is perhaps too broad, which type? To go into machine learning you’d need something related, however, ETH does accept cross-degree applicants, but then you’d have to take additional classes to “catch up”
comments.author: PhiDeltaChi
